defect_A.observed_behaviour: mode_smoke() returns {'mode': 'smoke', 'synthetic_only': True, 'scientific_output': False} without constructing any model, deserializing any checkpoint, running any forward, performing any autograd or producing any CAM.
defect_A.consequence: The authorized synthetic interface validation could not be performed; the v1.0b smoke gate correctly recorded BLOCKED.
defect_A.repair: v1.0c implements a real `mode_smoke()` exercising canonical G and B_phi only, with its own gate PHASE35_SMOKE_EXECUTE, synthetic-only deterministic inputs, no raw/GT/ROUTER_HOLDOUT/TEST reads, no optimizer/backward, and a parameter-immutability proof.

defect_B.summary: The frozen Grad-CAM target scalar indexes `logits[mask]`. The canonical G output tensor has shape [1,1,512,512], but the canonical scientific target-mask producer `build_target_mask(p_global)` returns a rank-2 [512,512] boolean array. PyTorch boolean indexing requires the mask shape to match the indexed tensor's leading dimensions, so `logits[mask]` raises IndexError for the canonical scientific inputs.
defect_B.evidence_1_static_tensor_semantics_probe: Model-free probe under the project interpreter (torch 2.6.0+cu124, CPU tensors): x shape (1,1,4,4); x[mask(4,4)] -> IndexError 'The shape of the mask [4, 4] at index 0 does not match the shape of the indexed tensor [1, 1, 4, 4] at index 0'; x[mask(1,1,4,4)] -> shape (4,). No model, checkpoint or dataset was involved.
defect_B.evidence_2_persisted_artifact_rank: Metadata-only npy header inspection (no array decompression, `gt` never accessed) of all 808 VAL npz under reports/predictions/phase21_global_medfilm_fourdomain_seed42_clean_v3/val: prob.npy = shape (512,512) dtype '<f2'; pred.npy = (512,512) '|u1'; gt.npy = (512,512) '|u1'. Hence build_target_mask yields rank 2.
defect_B.evidence_3_canonical_logits_rank: src/models/film/global_medfilm.py GlobalMedFiLM.forward returns `self.head(decoded)` with out_channels=1 (experiments/phase21_global_medfilm_fourdomain_seed42_clean_v3/config.json), i.e. rank-4 [B,1,512,512]; the frozen gradcam_gradient_enabled passes that tensor unchanged to gradcam_target_scalar.
defect_B.scientific_intent_unchanged: The frozen specification text (docs/phase35_interpretability_source_amendment_v1_0b.md §3) states: 'T uses current logits float32 under M_pred (full-field mean fallback when M_pred is empty)'. The intent is unambiguous; only the frozen implementation fails to realise it for rank-4 logits.
defect_B.v1_0c_behaviour: v1.0c does NOT modify the frozen helper. The synthetic smoke uses a rank-compatible synthetic mask [1,1,512,512] so the canonical path is exercised, and the incompatibility of the SCIENTIFIC mask producer is recorded in the smoke output (`mask_rank_contract`) and here.
defect_B.required_remediation: An additive v1.0d source amendment making the Grad-CAM target scalar rank-safe in a way that faithfully implements the frozen intent (e.g. indexing the per-sample foreground logits with the rank-2 spatial mask) while preserving the empty-mask full-field fallback. Scientific Grad-CAM execution remains BLOCKED until then.
